patterns.description: Domain-specific intent predicate in matchElement.ts: function checks for shopping/e-commerce vocabulary (cart, product, checkout, buy, purchase, add to cart) to decide which candidates to pre-filter. Violates the domain-agnostic rule in architecture.md.

Domain-specific guard in ExecutionLoop.ts: an if-block inspects the step intent for domain nouns (cart, product, checkout) to decide whether or how to call interact(). Violates the domain-agnostic rule — guards must be generic (e.g. isFillableTag) or removed.

high_risk_areas: src/llm/prompts/matchElement.ts — pre-filter functions must remain generic (action-type-based), never domain-specific. See architecture.md §Domain-Agnostic Design.
src/runner/ExecutionLoop.ts — guards around interact() must not test for shopping/e-commerce intent vocabulary.
